ash: FYI hit a weird one in the python sampleapp rerank flow — batching 5 docs into the rerank helper produced one embedding shorter by 2 dims. quick repro below.
noah: sdk + model? any retries or 500s?
ash: python-sdk v0.8.0, model=openembed-1536. No retries, single POST. Body looks consistent except one vector is length 1534.
ash: Raw response snippet (trimmed):
```json
{"results": [{"id":"d1","embedding":[0.01, 0.02, /* ... 1536 floats ... */]},
{"id":"d2","embedding":[0.03, 0.04, /* ... 1536 floats ... */]},
{"id":"d3","embedding":[0.05, 0.06, /* ... 1534 floats (two missing) ... */]},
{"id":"d4","embedding":[0.07, 0.08, /* ... 1536 floats ... */]}]}
```
tara: only when using the rerank batch helper or also raw embeddings call per doc?
ash: only via rerank helper. Calling embeddings endpoint for each doc yields 1536 every time. So likely something in the helper that merges embeddings+scores into a single bytes blob.
ash: helper code excerpt (simplified):
```py
def merge_embeddings(items):
    buf = bytearray()
    for vec in items:
        buf.extend(vec.tobytes())  # vec is numpy float32
    return memoryview(buf)

# later
out = np.frombuffer(merge_embeddings(vectors), dtype=np.float32)
out = out.reshape(len(vectors), 1536)
```
noah: iirc memoryview + frombuffer requires alignment. If any vec.tobytes() produced less bytes (maybe due to dtype mismatch or view with negative stride) reshape will silently carry into next block -> dimension mismatch.
eng-ml: tagging because this touches rerank response formatting and downstream similarity code. Two angles: (1) sampleapp helper should validate lengths before packing, (2) SDK should be robust to odd byte lengths from third-party libs.
ci-bot: CI: sampleapp/tests/test_rerank_batch.py failed on branch ash/rerank-pack-check  1 failing assert.
tara: short mitigation: add per-vector length assert and if mismatched, pad with zeros and log a warning including request_id. Also add an integration test that intentionally returns truncated bytes to ensure we detect it.
noah: can we also add defensive code around frombuffer/reshape try/except to surface a clearer error instead of a silent mis-shape?
ash: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/412 — adds validation + pad + test + changelog note.
ara: quick note for SDK parity: the JS helper concatenates Float32Array slices using set() and had a different off-by-one bug previously; worth syncing fixes across languages.
eng-ml: good call. I'll add a small compatibility test in our eval harness to run both sdk helpers on a fuzzed set of vectors.
ci-bot: deploy queued: sampleapp-tests pipeline for branch ash/rerank-pack-check started.
ash: request_id: rq_1Yb2kPz9. leaving the repro and failing test in samples/examples/rerank-truncation. will update here after green CI. :thumbsup:
